relationships.subject: PK2

key_findings: BTZ neuropathy raised spinal KDM6A early and PK2/IL-1β late; PKR antagonist PC1 reversed allodynia and these increases.
PKR blockade upregulated PPARα/PPARγ, suggesting PK2 tonically inhibits PPARs, possibly via KDM6A.
